memory_lessons.applicability: Use when selecting a serial/parallel crossover for this kernel; aggregate means alone do not establish the best threshold by size.
memory_lessons.claim: The seven observed T1 programs were distinct and valid, but their reported means are close; the available evidence does not settle the serial/OpenMP crossover for small or medium inputs.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Compare this conservative grain against the best prior candidate using controller timings across available sizes and thread budgets, with correctness and complete-output checks.

proposal.hypothesis: The T1 catalog reports seven distinct valid programs with no repeats; the best aggregate mean is 2a2949b870444487 at 0.0014007 s, while other recent OpenMP variants are close and do not establish a per-size crossover. This experiment contrasts their smaller grains and prior fixed cutoff with a conservative 1024-options-per-worker grain: it may avoid OpenMP overhead on small and medium inputs while retaining bounded static parallelism for larger work. No gain is assumed.

retained: Retained the serial kernel unchanged as a fallback and reference.
Added a static-scheduled OpenMP outer loop. Its team is min(threads, floor(count/1024)), so it does not request more workers than the passed budget or the available minimum work grains.
Kept the serial path for one-or-fewer threads and fewer than two 1024-option work grains; all positive-count iterations write their own result element.
